svg.aria-label: Bar chart of phonedriver against adb at p50 on an Android emulator, up to 170 times faster. read the screen (1,000-row UI tree): 12.7 ms against 2,163.7 ms for adb, 170 times faster; screenshot: 9.1 ms against 291.2 ms for adb, 32 times faster; type 100 characters: 158.3 ms against 3,638.4 ms for adb, 23 times faster; tap and see what changed: 514.0 ms against 2,477.2 ms for adb, 4.8 times faster. phone-harness is 186, 38, 25 times slower than phonedriver on the first 3 rows and does not support tap and see what changed.
